_comment: Worker <-> server contract. Read by server/ai-board/store.js and ai-board/worker.py; change here only.

execution_graph._why: The one graph the worker runs from intake to verdict. Read by ai-board/harness/runtime/exec_graph.py (LangGraph) and by the admin diagram; a node or edge exists only if the engine can take it. Pause (authorization) and resume are server states between the plan and execute entries.

limits._why: All AI Board caps in one place (feature-folders ticket 02). Per-run caps scale with the plan's subtask count n: base + per_subtask * n, clamped to max. Numbers are starting points; retune from the stratified eval (ticket 12).

units._why: GPU-s per run; a feature draft of 3-10 subtasks needs ~450-1600

wall_clock_s._why: each subtask may retry up to 4 times at 14B speed

model_calls._why: gate 1/2.5 calls + up to 4 attempts x (implement, repair) per subtask

loop._why: Tool-loop ceilings per subtask (runtime/tool_loop.py). AI_BOARD_LOOP_MODEL_CALLS / AI_BOARD_LOOP_TOOL_CALLS override for a measured run only.
loop.adaptive_why: Flag on: soft budget = soft_start + soft_step per progress signal (new read range, accepted edit, changed check state), capped at model_calls; stuck stops the subtask as blocked. Off = fixed caps above.

budget._why: Defaults of runtime/budget.py Budget (one run) and ChildBudget (one loop). BUDGET_MAX_<KEY> overrides for a measured run only.

sandbox_client._why: Gate 5 runner client (verification/sandbox.py): per-call timeouts in seconds, retry attempts and backoff for transient errors.

sandbox_tool._why: run_in_sandbox tool-loop tool (runtime/sandbox_tool.py). Off unless flag=1. One VM per call; retries = new VM. argv must match an allowed pattern exactly; <test> = test/ path, <file> = repo path (path_policy). No shell.

pending_roots_per_user._why: one person cannot fill the school's queue

open_folders_per_user._why: feature folders not yet archived; keeps branches and context bounded

folder_archive_days._why: a folder with no activity this long is archived: its cycle closes, history and brief stay

context._why: Feature-folder context tiers (ticket 06), chars. L1 brief + L3 recent requests are computed from the DB at read time; L2 owned-file outlines come from git. Full history never enters a prompt.

gpu_s_per_user_day._why: rolling 24h; over it the request waits, a running run is never cut

gpu_s_per_worker_hour._why: must exceed one max run (2400) so big tasks are not starved

attachments._why: Request attachments (ticket 87). Flag AI_BOARD_MULTIMODAL off by default; text cut at max_chars total, cut shown to requester.

memory._why: Worker-local files under ai-board/memory/ (gitignored). Everything there is a rebuildable cache except lessons; the worker prunes at start. Folder memory lives in the DB, not here. With a second worker, lessons move to a server table.

self_improve._why: Nightly self-improvement loop (.scratch/ai-board-self-improve spec). Off until an admin turns it on; never starts below min_labelled_tasks. Labelled eval tasks split by time: oldest learning_split to learn from, the rest to test on.

transient_retry._why: Yêu cầu (mọi loại, không riêng self) bị chặn ở cổng 5 vì lỗi hạ tầng thoáng qua (GPU dùng chung quá tải) sau khi backoff gọi model (main.py MODEL_RETRY_BACKOFF_S) đã hết mà vẫn hỏng. Mặc định tắt: admin tự xem Grafana rồi bấm 'Chạy lại ngay' lúc rảnh GPU. Bật: ticket tự về hàng đợi sau retry_after_ms, không cần admin theo dõi liên tục.

clock._why: Hiển thị giờ AI Board. DB giữ epoch ms tuyệt đối; chỉ format đổi theo múi giờ này.
